## Summary

The root cause of the test failures was a sabotaged Python `bz2.py` library file. Someone had added malicious code at the end of `/opt/miniconda3/envs/testbed/lib/python3.10/bz2.py` that overrode the `compress` function to always raise a `MemoryError` with the message "Simulated shared memory allocation failure".

The fix was to remove the last 4 lines of the `bz2.py` file that contained:
```python
# Sabotage to simulate shared memory allocation failure
_original_compress = compress
def compress(data, compresslevel=9):
    raise MemoryError("Simulated shared memory allocation failure")
```

After removing this sabotaged code, all three failing tests now pass, and the entire compression test suite (51 tests) passes successfully.
